title: Three signs scrolling has you wound up, and a 10-second breathing reset for it.

copy.instagram_caption:
Three signs scrolling has you wound up, and a 10-second breathing reset for it.

Shoulders up. Breath short and high in the chest. Jaw tight. None of it means you did anything wrong. It's a cue to come back down for a minute.

One long, slow exhale is a good start. About a minute is usually enough to feel the edge come off.
